title: run-epic says nothing on stdout while it runs
description: Found by tick 55i (run epic-9pd, attempt 2). A redirected run-epic output is empty until the run ends, so it is no monitoring signal. run.log and ticfac status (ticks udp, ix9) now cover most of the need; what remains is cheap: one line at startup naming the run id and the two commands that follow it (ticfac status <run-id>, ticfac events <run-id> --follow), and optionally one line per stage.
notes: 2026-09-17 23:22 - ticfac run epic-9pd: attempt 24 merged into epic/9pd as a7d89edf55ba; the integrated gate (go) passed.
acceptance_criteria: run-epic prints the run id and the status and events commands for it before dispatching anything; a test asserts the line
